Resume paused projects.

Removes spec.paused from the manifest of each named project, so slipway fetch and slipway sync act
on it again. A project that is not paused prints not paused.

Usage: slipway rollout resume [OPTIONS] (<NAME>... | project/<NAME>...)

Arguments:
  <NAME>...
          The name of a project.

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h').

Examples:
  # Resume the paused project dots
  slipway rollout resume dots

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
